chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), from his forefathers (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'A man does not leave behind upon his family with something superior than two Cycles (of Prayer) which he Prays when intending the going out to travel.'
He should be saying, 'O Allah! I entrust to You, myself, and my family, and my wealth, and my offspring, and my world, and my Hereafter, and my entrustments, and the completion of my (pending) works'
except that Allah would Give him what he asks for'.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended prayer and supplication for a Muslim to perform before traveling?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlighting the spiritual protection afforded to the household during the head of the family's absence. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on integrating daily domestic life with divine trust (tawakkul), ensuring that the family's worldly and spiritual well-being remains under Allah's guardianship while the provider is away. The promise of receiving exactly what is asked for reflects the theological principle of Allah's responsiveness to sincere, specific supplications made with certainty.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘A mam will not leave behind upon his family with something superior than two Cycles (of Prayer) which he Prays when intending the going out to travel.

He should be saying, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I entrust to You<sup>azwj</sup>, myself, and my family, and my wealth, and my offspring, and my world, and my Hereafter, and my entrustments, and the completion of my (pending) works’,
except that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Give him what he asks for’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy, from al-Sakuniy who has said the following from his ancestors: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said,
’No deputy is better for a man to leave behind for his family than two Rak’at salat (prayer).
At the time of coming out, one should say, “O Lord, I leave in Your trust my family, property, children, my worldly affairs, my next life, my trust and end-result of my deeds”,
